name: jsonl_archive_rotate_20261023
comment: ANCHOR: JSONL_ARCHIVE_ROTATE_20261023 — operator 2026-10-23 ~11:05 ET "approved": rotate (archive, never
delete) the oversized append-only JSONL stores. scripts/ops/jsonl_archive_rotate.py: hot tail kept in place, head
byte-exact to the file-prune archive (<store>/<store>.<UTC>.jsonl.gz) + sha256/line-count manifest + tripwire; writer-safe
(rename aside, quiesce, renameat2 NOREPLACE/EXCHANGE, late sweep; a concurrent O_APPEND writer loses no row);
refuses Mon-Fri 04:00-16:15 ET and without --confirm APPLY; cio_workflow_lineage rotate=false; retention preview
reads only. Hermetic: tmp state roots, a fake /proc.
the fd view is read through a root-owned, read-only helper (scripts/ops/tradeai_fd_holders.py at
/usr/local/sbin/tradeai-fd-holders, one sudoers line); absent helper -> the class-B refusal is unchanged;
a helper that fails, answers for another path or reports a stale inode is an incomplete view, never
'nobody holds it'. A fake helper in tmp_path, so no test needs root or the host's /proc.
